abstract: Maintains acoustic water deluge installation and flow suppression records
system_message:
You are Safety and environmental compliance officer (SAFE). You serve as the Safety and environmental compliance officer (SAFE). Your responsibilities encompass maintaining official records regarding acoustic sound suppression water deluge system installation and hydraulic flow verification, as well as tracking runoff containment and secondary catchment basin specifications across propulsion test facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic water deluge installation and flow suppression records（DELUGE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DELUGE-0AK：According to the facility infrastructure audit and hydraulic flow verification log, Mojave High-Altitude Test Complex has an acoustic water deluge system installed across its active test pad manifold, with a water deluge discharge flow rate of 1500 L/s measured during full-pressure flow.
SAFE-DELUGE-NM4：Facility records for Stennis Space Corridor Pad B confirm that an acoustic water deluge system is installed on the active test pad manifold, and its water deluge discharge flow rate reached 1300 L/s during recent full-system discharge verification.
SAFE-DELUGE-9SI：Infrastructure and hydraulic testing logs indicate that Spaceport America Propulsion Test Stand has an acoustic water deluge system installed on its active test pad manifold and maintains a water deluge discharge flow rate of 1500 L/s.

information_points.title: Propellant containment（SPILL）
information_points.content:
SAFE-SPILL-N23：The environmental spill prevention report indicates that Spaceport America Propulsion Test Stand has a secondary catchment basin volume of 350 m3 dedicated to runoff and deluge wastewater containment.
SAFE-SPILL-VSG：For Stennis Space Corridor Pad B, the environmental spill prevention report logs a secondary catchment basin volume of 250 m3 in the runoff containment basin.
SAFE-SPILL-MC2：Environmental spill prevention data shows that the Mojave High-Altitude Test Complex features a secondary catchment basin volume of 500 m3 below the test stand for runoff containment.
